summary: Milestone 6 adds REST Content and Admin APIs, outbound signed webhooks, and product integrations (Unsplash, Slack, optional AI assist, consent-gated analytics) on Cloudron beta.
detailed_changes: Content API (/api/content/v1) serves published posts, pages, and tags with a site Content API key; body HTML only for public visibility.
Admin API (/api/admin/v1) supports staff token writes and publish transitions through BlockValidator and PostPayloadRules.
Outbound webhooks deliver post.published, member.created, and subscription.updated with HMAC-SHA256 signing and queued retries without blocking publish.
Staff integrations: Unsplash media picker, Slack editorial alerts, optional AI draft assist (off by default), and consent-gated Plausible/GTM-stub analytics hooks.
affected_areas: Page or route: /api/content/v1, /api/admin/v1, /staff/webhooks, staff editor media/AI, /analytics/consent, /legal/cookies
User groups affected: headless clients; staff editors; visitors (analytics consent)
Public impact: optional third-party analytics only after consent; APIs for published content
Internal impact: no production cutover, live Stripe reopen, Ghost retirement, or new live-send authorization
